params.body: The keys page named a passkey after the browser's platform string: a YubiKey read "MacIntel", an Android phone "Linux armv81", and renaming did not exist. Now each key has a name its owner gives (rename inline, owner only), and the page says what the key is, read from the credential: **hardware** (one device, non-exportable, what the DID log may publish) or **synced** (a passkey a cloud copies between devices; fine for signing in, never a key of the identity), with the maker from the AAGUID (YubiKey 5 series / Bio, Apple iCloud Keychain, Google Password Manager). Existing rows need no migration: the kind is read from the stored credential. Tests: kinds from the credential and the page's words; the owner renames, a client cannot. PHPStan clean.
params.title: Keys: a name the owner gives, and the kind read from the credential
